snippet.title: Responding | Official Early Access Gameplay Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Responding is available now in Early Access! #PlayResponding, is an open-world emergency services sandbox simulator, offering realistic and in-depth experiences as a police officer in a fictional version of New York State, and as we expand, will also include fire department and EMS gameplay.
